who: Real stack · real SMTP/IMAP · local stand-ins for the data APIs and CRM
title: From a CSV export to a booked call, without spamming anyone
sub: Merge, verify, enrich and score leads with reasons, send a short threaded sequence, read the replies, and hand only real interest to the CRM.
outro: Python · FastAPI · SQLite · SMTP/IMAP · HubSpot-style CRM API · Docker · e2e in GitHub Actions.
thumbTitle: Leads scored with reasons, replies sorted

caps.text: An Apollo export with 20 rows: duplicates, a broken address, a shared inbox, a personal Gmail
Columns recognised, 18 new leads, the duplicate merged, the broken row skipped, each with its reason
Each lead is verified and enriched by company domain, then scored against the ideal-customer rules
Every point is explained, so a salesperson can see why
Qualified leads get a personal first email, sent in office hours under a daily cap
The replies come in by email: one interested, one out of office until a date, one asking to stop
Lena wants a call: her sequence stops and she goes to the CRM as a contact with a deal
Out of office until a date: the next email waits until the day after
Asked to stop: suppressed for good, a later import can't bring her back
Everyone else gets the follow-ups as replies in the same thread
